proposed_capability: P95 design + P124 integration + Trifecta: treat right-click of independently verified active Sim portrait as primary follow-camera control, distinguish Enter one-time center and Shift+Enter lot center, resolve overlays/events, active bottom-right panels and preserved action queues, and codify wrong-scene observations into bounded reusable scene knowledge without granting blind navigation or permissions.
player_save_control_impact: No game save or installed mod edits; read-only machine semantics unless a local operator-authorized exact-PID/session, active Live scene, user-idle input gate and dynamically attested portrait hitbox admit a right-click. No global hooks, autonomous scheduler, raw screenshot persistence or cross-app keyboard monitoring.
expected_outcome: Agent default follows its currently active Sim by fresh, exact portrait right-click; Enter remains one-time center fallback and Shift+Enter centers lot only. Overlay response/recovery preserves queued objectives until independent event decision, panel activation uses two cues and target/panel revisions, and unexpected scenery creates deduplicated reusable candidate record requiring review before navigation.
negative_tests: No uncalibrated portrait click or arbitrary coordinates
No right-click on world or wrong household Sim
No automatic Escape when modal unknown
No choices made for ambiguous career/random event
Unknown or overlapping bottom-right panel blocks click
Panel context changes after overlay invalidate old hitboxes
Actions queue continuation requires fresh revalidation
Wrong scenery logged without teaching that it is desired target
Discovered scenery cannot be revisited on stale evidence
No blind keyboard or game-save mutation
rollback_path: Revert dedicated PR through GitHub; no game saves, active sessions, installed Mods or user account settings changed.
unresolved_unknowns: Live game right-click following/active portrait targeting requires exact local game UI calibration and confirmation
External Playwright agents must route through canonical host seam to enforce event and mouse rules
